items.source: the number of bean definitions found
items.translation: 找到的 Bean 定义数量

items.source: Return the BeanNameGenerator to use for anonymous beans (without explicit bean name specified).
items.translation: 返回用于匿名 Bean（未显式指定 Bean 名称）的BeanNameGenerator。

items.source: Return the Environment associated with this component.
items.translation: 返回与此组件关联的Environment。

items.source: If the passed-in bean factory also implements EnvironmentCapable its environment will be used by this reader. Otherwise, the reader will initialize and use a StandardEnvironment. All ApplicationContext implementations are EnvironmentCapable, while normal BeanFactory implementations are not.
items.translation: 如果传入的 BeanFactory 也实现了EnvironmentCapable，则此读取器将使用其环境。否则，读取器将初始化并使用一个StandardEnvironment。所有 ApplicationContext 实现都是 EnvironmentCapable，而普通的 BeanFactory 实现则不是。

items.source: The location can also be a location pattern, provided that the ResourceLoader of this bean definition reader is a ResourcePatternResolver.
items.translation: 位置也可以是位置模式，前提是此 Bean 定义读取器的ResourceLoader是一个ResourcePatternResolver。

items.source: If the passed-in bean factory does not only implement the BeanDefinitionRegistry interface but also the ResourceLoader interface, it will be used as default ResourceLoader as well. This will usually be the case for ApplicationContext implementations.
items.translation: 如果传入的 BeanFactory 不仅实现了 BeanDefinitionRegistry 接口，还实现了 ResourceLoader 接口，那么它也将被用作默认的 ResourceLoader。通常情况下，ApplicationContext 的实现类会符合这一情况。

items.source: If given a plain BeanDefinitionRegistry, the default ResourceLoader will be a PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver.
items.translation: 如果给定一个普通的 BeanDefinitionRegistry，默认的 ResourceLoader 将是 PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver。

items.source: The factory is exposed through the BeanDefinitionRegistry interface, encapsulating the methods that are relevant for bean definition handling.
items.translation: 工厂通过 `BeanDefinitionRegistry` 接口暴露，封装了与 Bean 定义处理相关的方法。

items.source: There is also a loadBeanDefinitions(String) method available, for loading bean definitions from a resource location (or location pattern). This is a convenience to avoid explicit ResourceLoader handling.
items.translation: 还有一个可用的 `loadBeanDefinitions(String)` 方法，用于从资源位置（或位置模式）加载 Bean 定义。这是一种便利机制，以避免显式处理 `ResourceLoader`。

items.source: Default is a DefaultBeanNameGenerator.
items.translation: 默认值为一个DefaultBeanNameGenerator。

items.source: Setting this to null suggests that absolute resource loading is not available for this bean definition reader.
items.translation: 将此设置为null表明该 Bean 定义读取器不可用绝对资源加载。

items.source: Can be checked for the ResourcePatternResolver interface and cast accordingly, for loading multiple resources for a given resource pattern.
items.translation: 可用于检查 `ResourcePatternResolver` 接口并据此进行类型转换，以便为给定的资源模式加载多个资源。

items.source: A null return value suggests that absolute resource loading is not available for this bean definition reader.
items.translation: null 返回值表明该 BeanDefinitionReader 不可用绝对资源加载。

items.source: Default is null, which suggests to not load bean classes eagerly but rather to just register bean definitions with class names, with the corresponding Classes to be resolved later (or never).
items.translation: 默认为 `null`，这表示不急于加载 Bean 类，而只是注册带有类名的 Bean 定义，相应的 Class 稍后（或永远）再解析。

items.source: null suggests to not load bean classes eagerly but rather to just register bean definitions with class names, with the corresponding classes to be resolved later (or never).
items.translation: null 建议不要急切加载 Bean 类，而是仅注册带有类名的 Bean 定义，相应的类将在稍后（或永远）解析。

items.source:
Provides common properties like the bean factory to work on
and the class loader to use for loading bean classes.
items.translation: 提供诸如 BeanFactory 等通用属性以进行操作，并提供用于加载 Bean 类的类加载器。

items.source:
Default is PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver, also capable of
resource pattern resolving through the ResourcePatternResolver interface.
items.translation: 默认为 PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver，同时也支持通过 ResourcePatternResolver 接口进行资源模式解析。

items.source:
This is mainly meant to be used for importing further resources
from within a bean definition resource, for example via the "import"
tag in XML bean definitions. It is recommended, however, to apply
such imports relative to the defining resource; only explicit full
resource locations will trigger absolute path based resource loading.
items.translation: 这主要用于从 Bean 定义资源内部导入其他资源，例如通过 XML Bean 定义中的"import"标签。然而，建议相对于定义的资源应用此类导入；只有显式的完整资源位置才会触发基于绝对路径的资源加载。

items.source:
The location can also be a location pattern, provided that the
ResourceLoader of this bean definition reader is a ResourcePatternResolver.
items.translation: 位置也可以是位置模式，前提是此 Bean 定义读取器的 `ResourceLoader` 是一个 `ResourcePatternResolver`。
